apps.localizedDescription:
Velunivo:

Your route. Your riding speed.

An iOS-first navigator and route planner for e-scooters and e-bikes. Compare bicycle and car-road candidates, estimate travel time for the vehicle you actually ride, and plan on a fullscreen map with floating controls. Built with Expo and React Native for iPhone, iPad, Android and web.

Built around your ride:

Scheduled ETAs exclude traffic conditions and traffic simulation. An optional current traffic overlay does not change the ETA. Battery use is an estimate based on range, speed and available elevation; Bluetooth battery percentage is a separate actual reading.

Get the app:

Choose your installed sideloading app on AltDirect, or copy the source URL below. The link opens the chooser without automatically launching an app.

privacy.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Velunivo connects to supported vehicles for read-only speed and battery telemetry.
privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Use the camera for vehicle pictures and optional group ride video. Live video is shared only with opted-in riders.

privacy.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: Allow Velunivo to access your location
privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Velunivo uses your location for ride guidance and recording.
